purpose: Freeze what an eventual real-sky validation will compare and how set-valued model and measurement uncertainties are represented, without selecting numeric PASS/FAIL thresholds before Pandora radiometric uncertainty and external AOD support are resolved.

spectralBoundary.reason: ASIV ordinal 39 passed integrated scalar and derived Level-B gates but did not establish a full-spectrum aerosol interpolation PASS; 26634 spectral nodes remained unresolved.

measurementUncertainty.ifCovarianceUnavailable: use a conservative bounded/interval propagation or separately report correlated calibration and pointwise components; do not invent root-sum-square independence

atmosphereInputRepresentation.aod550: external set-valued support interval derived without Pandora target radiance

modelPredictionSet.forEachObservation: evaluate each permitted aerosol scenario over the entire externally admitted AOD550 support interval at the observation's frozen geometry and other external atmosphere inputs

extremaRule.requirement: min/max over the full admitted AOD interval must be obtained by an independently frozen deterministic method; endpoints alone may not be assumed sufficient unless monotonicity is proven for the relevant channel/model

nativeLogResidual.reason: preserves an interpretable baseline bias diagnostic independent of scenario-family selection

scenarioSetMissDistanceLog.definition: zero when the measurement uncertainty interval intersects the modeled scenario-by-AOD support set; otherwise the minimum absolute log-distance between the two sets

measurementIntervalCoveredByModelSet.definition: boolean overlap of measured uncertainty interval and modeled scenario-by-AOD support set

nearestScenarioDiagnostic.reason: useful to diagnose which frozen scenario is closest, but choosing it after observing radiance would be post-hoc family fitting

aggregateMetrics.reason: prevent high-cadence rows from one twilight session from dominating independent nights/sessions
forEachPrimaryChannelReport: session-level mean absolute native log residual
session-level mean scenario-set miss distance in log units
session-level fraction of admitted observation intervals intersecting the model set
across-session median and worst of each preregistered session metric
aggregateMetrics.reasonAdditionalSummariesFrozen: avoid choosing flattering summaries after seeing residuals

geometryAndAtmosphereDiagnostics.reason: diagnostic structure should not become an outcome-dependent subgroup rescue

beforeNumericGatesCanFreeze: exact Pandora209 s1/s2 absolute-radiance calibration and uncertainty semantics resolved
traceable metadata-only s1/s2 pairing and stitching algorithm resolved
external AOD temporal-support and uncertainty rule frozen
